root_cause_findings: Discovery labels optimized single-instrument local counterfactual reward, while final success is multi-instrument cashflow-adjusted account equity.
The learned long path clustered across correlated instruments and accumulated 2x gross notional before a broad drawdown, breaching the 5x account leverage ceiling.
This is not inactivity: the replayable policies activated frequently.
Three owner artifacts were not fully replay-complete, preventing honest certification of their complete model behavior.
next_generation_only_after_user_approval: Move portfolio concurrency, correlation, gross-notional occupation, pending positions, and withdrawal-adjusted equity into discovery-time account reward rather than applying them only after path discovery.
Require every model submission to export replay-complete fitted parameters or an owner-blind neutral prediction artifact before validation.
Treat correlated-position admission and account-aware sizing as learned routing outputs; do not merely add a tighter subjective pre-filter.
Preserve the hard ruin gate, treat drawdown as soft, and treat failure to activate a certified match as an explicit failure.
